sources.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
sources.evidence: Introduces Sol and Luna in the GPT-6 generation, trained with similar methods to Astra. Explicitly releases them through Work, Codex and the API, while Chat availability is still future. Describes coding and professional workflows; performance and price comparisons are not parameter counts.

sources.title: GPT-6 Sol API model reference
sources.evidence: Exact reference lists the undated gpt-6-sol snapshot, 1,050,000 context, 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output. It specifies text/image input, text output, reasoning and tools, including the Chat Completions function-calling exception when reasoning_effort is none.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: September 22 explicitly releases gpt-6-sol. September 25 fixes image encoding in the API and Codex. The September 29 GPT-6.1 Sol launch names a separate model; neither update changes the original release date.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra System Card — Appendix A: GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna
sources.evidence: The September 22 appendix identifies Sol, links its data/training methods to the main card, and reports exact Sol evaluations. Section A.7.1.1 examines Sol chain-of-thought controllability. Reviewed training sections, exact comparison columns and full-text structural terms disclose no production total/active count or network architecture.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-6 Astra System Card: GPT-6.1 Sol
sources.evidence: Later September 29 card includes exact GPT-6 Sol comparisons, including Tables 12 and 13 and chain-of-thought examples. These contain evaluation scores and behavior, not production parameter counts or network topology.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-6 Astra System Card: GPT-6.1 Terra
sources.evidence: October 26 card has exact GPT-6 Sol columns, including HealthBench performance and response lengths, and later alignment comparisons. No total/active production count or architectural designation for Sol was found in the reviewed text.

sources.title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna: October 2026 update
sources.evidence: October 7 card explicitly distinguishes new ChatGPT October variants from September versions retained in Work and Codex. Training and comparison sections do not disclose Sol parameter counts or network architecture. This is not evidence of an identical API checkpoint or a change to the original release date.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses and Chat Completions support PDF inputs. Vision-capable models receive extracted text and page images; with exact Sol vision support, this establishes PDF as an API document format, not a separate native modality.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant limited service/API access while reserving service intellectual property. Combined with hosted model distribution, supports a descriptive Proprietary classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Prompt caching
sources.evidence: Current guide describes reusable key/value states and supports GPT-6 caching. It does not specify Sol production topology or numerical parameters; KV terminology alone is insufficient to establish a Transformer or MoE classification.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived article explains Transformer attention but explicitly applies only to models before GPT-5.6. Its structural explanation is not transferred to GPT-6 Sol.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: Exact gpt-6-sol mentions are replacement recommendations for older models; no shutdown entry for Sol was found. This is documentation review, not a live endpoint test.

sources.title: OpenAI EU AI Act resources
sources.evidence: The current training-summary list includes GPT-6 Astra but no exact GPT-6 Sol summary. Astra training-data volumes are not transferred as Sol parameter counts or native API modalities.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-6 Sol record
sources.evidence: The original catalog lead was accessed through its raw file. Its release date, context and capabilities were independently checked against primary documentation; its cross-generation gpt-sol grouping is corrected.

family.note: GPT-6 is the generation; Sol identifies its tier. Correct the cross-generation gpt-sol grouping.

release_date.note: Explicit API/public release; subsequent encoding fix, successor and October ChatGPT variant are separate events.

open_weights.note: Reviewed distribution is hosted service/API access, with no Sol checkpoint or weight redistribution license offered.

license.note: Descriptive classification under hosted service terms, not a downloadable-weight or SPDX license.

parameters_b.note: No production total in original training sections or later exact-model comparisons. Bounded first-party parameter, architecture and interpretability searches found no disclosure. Scores, training-data quantities and sibling models do not supply a count.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active count or activation/routing inventory disclosed in the checked exact-model sources; total=active is not inferred.

architecture.note: The checked original/later training and monitoring material does not establish production Transformer, dense or MoE topology. Similar training methods are not shared architecture; the older Transformer caching explanation excludes this generation.

context_window.note: Documented API limit, with explicit 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output. Only the undated identifier is listed.

modalities.note: Text/image are native inputs; PDF is an API file format processed into text and page images. Image-generation tool access is not native image output.

reasoning.note: Supports none, low, medium (default), high, xhigh and max. An optional none setting does not negate reasoning support.

tool_call.note: Responses supports tools with reasoning. Chat Completions function calling is supported only with reasoning_effort=none; do not transfer Astra restrictions.

description.value: OpenAI model for complex coding and agentic workflows
description.note: Retain the factual description supported by the exact model reference and launch.

patch.notes: Public/API release was September 22, 2026. The API reference lists only the undated gpt-6-sol identifier: 1,050,000 context, 922,000 maximum input and 128,000 output. Reasoning defaults to medium and supports none through max. Responses supports reasoning with tools; Chat Completions function calling requires reasoning_effort=none. PDF is converted to text and page images. September 25 corrected image encoding; October 7 introduced a distinct ChatGPT version, while Work and Codex retained September versions. Those events do not establish an identical or replacement production API checkpoint. Total/active parameters remain undisclosed and production architecture unverified in the original and later exact-model evidence checked. No exact Sol API shutdown notice was found; endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: Correct generation family and proprietary classification, and replace catalog-only provenance with primary evidence. Confirm September 22 release, explicit context limits, modalities, reasoning and tools including the Chat Completions none-effort exception. Retain factual description. Counts remain undisclosed and architecture unverified after original and later exact-model checks; distinguish encoding fixes and October product variants.
